status_summary: No DOL investigation, enforcement action or rule directed at worker centers was found. The Office of Labor-Management Standards published a final rule on 2026-06-01, effective 2026-07-01, revising union annual financial report forms LM-2, LM-3 and LM-4; a Federal Register full-text search matched the phrase worker centers in that document, but the portions of the rule text read did not show the phrase or any Department position on worker centers.
title: Investigate worker centers as labor organizations and require financial disclosures
uncertainties: Absence-of-evidence finding. The rule text is long and the fetch tool returned it in parts; in review both parts were searched for the phrase worker centers without a match, so where the full-text search hit lies was not established. Checks run: Federal Register API full-text search for worker centers since 2025-01-20 (one document); two WebSearches (one by the researcher that returned commentary and a 2024 congressional letter, one in review on OLMS and worker centers that returned only the LM-2 rule pages and commentary), and fetches of the rule. OLMS enforcement releases and criminal enforcement actions were not searched individually.
